title: People were eating, drinking, marrying, celebrating.
paragraphs:
People were eating, drinking, marrying, celebrating.
Life felt normal.
Jesus said the last days would look the same.

“As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.”
— Matthew 24:37

The danger wasn’t violence alone.
It was normal life without God.

A generation distracted.
A world unprepared.
Noah built the ark while everyone else laughed.
And when the rain started… it was too late.

The question is not if Christ will return.
The question is who will be ready.
Are we living watchfully — or just living normally?
“Do you think our world today looks like the days of Noah? Why or why not?”
